item.summary: Pete Hegseth says Iran should make a deal to end the war as Secretary of State Marco Rubio cites internal fractures in the new Iranian regime.

item.title: Missing paddleboarder found dead in Old Tampa Bay after a weekend disappearance near the causeway
item.summary: A man who went missing while paddleboarding near the Courtney Campbell Causeway was found dead in Old Tampa Bay on Monday, police said. Foul play is not suspected.

item.title: Jenny McCarthy endures 'living hell' as hidden dental infection leads to shocking health crisis
